designations.Secretary General: Senior management — full control incl. staff, settings and final approvals
designations.President (Signatory): Signs letters and certificates; views everything else
designations.Deputy Secretary — Membership: Runs the membership desk; approves extensions, class changes, revocations
designations.Membership Officer: Reviews applications, issues temporary memberships, uploads certificates
designations.Services Officer: Handles the seven service requests up to signing
designations.Accounts Officer: Issues vouchers and verifies bank receipts
designations.Committee Secretary: Records Membership Committee decisions and minutes
designations.Front Desk / Data Entry: Enters member records and complaints; no approvals
designations.Membership Committee Convener: Approves or declines new membership applications (committee assigned by the SG, approved by the President)
designations.Membership Committee Member: Sees the files with the committee and adds notes for the Convener
designations.IT Convener: The only person who may download or export confidential data; runs the platform settings

roles.Owner: Authorized representative — everything, incl. inviting colleagues
roles.Manager: Applies, pays and manages documents; cannot manage users
roles.Services: Requests services (C.O., visa letters…) and downloads documents
roles.Accounts: Pays vouchers and uploads receipts only

sign.title: Sign and declare
sign.stampOptional: Optional for proprietors · take a photo of your stamp on white paper
sign.stampHelp: Take a photo of your stamp on white paper
sign.decl1: I am desirous of becoming member of the Multan Chamber of Commerce & Industry, I have read and understand Memorandum and Articles of Association and By Laws of this Chamber and I agree to abide by the same. If at any stage I will not abide by or breach any Rules and Regulations as defined in the Memorandum and Articles of Association and By Laws of the Multan Chamber of Commerce & Industry so in that case the Multan Chamber of Commerce & Industry will have the right to cancel my membership. I will pay Admission Fee along with Annual Subscription Fee subject to approval of my application by the Membership Committee of the Multan Chamber of Commerce & Industry.
sign.decl2: I declare that the particulars given in this Application Form are true to the best of my knowledge and belief and that I have no criminal conviction and that nothing has been concealed.

guide.title: What to do on this step
guide.type: Choose Manufacturing or Non-manufacturing, then your type of business. Answer the class questions (if shown) and choose what your business does. Your class and fee appear at the bottom.
guide.docs: Upload each document on the list — a phone photo or a PDF is fine. Then press "Read with AI" and the form fills itself. A wrong or unclear document does not stop you; MCCI will tell you if anything else is needed.
guide.details: Check every field. Yellow fields were read by AI — please confirm them. Add the authorized representative's email and address, and every partner / director with their email.
guide.endorse: Choose two MCCI members of your class who know your business. They only press Approve in their own portal — no signature or code is needed.
guide.sign: Sign on the screen or upload a photo of your signature, add the company stamp, and tick both declarations.
guide.review: Read your official form once. If anything is listed as still needed, go back and add it. Then press Submit — MCCI will contact you through this portal.

Every change is recorded in the audit log. Then each of them gets an email invitation to MCCI Digital (as the Owner of their company, to the email in the file; valid 30 days).

membership.title: Membership
membership.sub: Apply online on the official MCCI form. Temporary membership for 60 days from fee verification, permanent when your secure certificate arrives.
membership.feeSub: As printed on the MCCI New Membership form.
membership.corporateSub: Body corporate, multinational, sales-tax-registered manufacturer, or sales-tax-registered business with turnover ≥ Rs. {turnover}.
membership.associateSub: Every other business concern within MCCI’s jurisdiction.
membership.womenSub: Corporate or Associate class, for women-owned businesses.
membership.extraCard: Extra card for a partner / director: PKR {fee}.

membership.docsNote: Business address must match the NTN certificate. Application must be proposed and seconded by two valid MCCI members — you choose them and they sign online.
membership.endorseSub: You choose two existing members of your category; they approve and sign from their own portal.
membership.journeySub: Eight steps — you see each one live on your dashboard and by email.

membership.t2Sub: Your certificate is printed on security paper with a unique serial while you use services.

certs.title: Certificates
certs.sub: Upload the scans of the certificates printed by the security press. Each is read, matched to the member and checked by a person; on confirmation its QR code is printed on the scan.
certs.kFailedSub: Check by hand or upload again
certs.uploadHelp: JPG or PNG, one certificate per file, up to 10 MB each; several at once. The same scan is never taken twice.
certs.confirmHelp: Check the scan against the member. Confirming creates the certificate QR code and prints it on the scan. The member’s number and validity are not changed.
certs.overrideHelp: The scan does not fully match the register (see the conflicts). Confirm only if you are sure, with the reason.
certs.override: I checked the conflicts and confirm anyway
certs.needApprover: This scan has conflicts: only the certificate approver (Secretary General / Deputy Secretary) can confirm it.

conflicts.name_mismatch: company name differs from the register
conflicts.already_certified: member already has a valid certificate (it will be superseded)
conflicts.member_changed: a different member than the reading

done.confirmed: Confirmed for {no}: QR {code} printed on the certificate.
